purpose: Sanitized reference for the original solve-then-evaluate experiment; not an executable platform submission specification.

evidence: Read-only inspection of the reference job parameters and rendered environment
Local copy of the matching evaluation tools, identified by TOOLS_VERSION

task_population.scheduling_unit: One case per job, with solve followed by evaluation in the same job
task_population.solver_input: User request, initial application, and task assets; no evaluation rubric
task_population.evaluation_input: The same task plus the fixed expert-authored rubric and final solver workspace

requested_launch_configuration.note: These are the supplied launch settings, not a claim about the group's current scheduling state.

interpretation.judge_browser_enabled: Disables the optional live Playwright MCP interaction session. Mandatory browser rendering and screenshot/DOM evidence still run before judging.
interpretation.viewport: 1440x900 configures the optional interaction browser. The inspected headless Chrome renderer separately defaults to a 1440x1600 screenshot; these are different settings.
interpretation.platform_pass_score_threshold: A platform job-level flag; it is not the benchmark's full-task-pass metric, which requires every fixed criterion to PASS.
interpretation.budgets: The 43200-second solve allowance, 45000-second enclosing solve stage, 43200-second evaluation budget, and 7200-second individual judge call timeout apply at different levels.

public_runner.relationship: Portable reference implementation; not the original platform harness
differences: Supports static HTML and supported npm build outputs rather than all original rendering and runtime adapters
Uses independent live Playwright evidence in both judging stages
Requires both stages to succeed and rejects verifier upgrades; does not fall back to an unverified primary result
Validates fixed task IDs, exact criterion text/order, and evidence artifact paths
Does not implement the original low-score solvability attribution or platform scheduling
